name: colony-morphometry
domain: quantitative morphometry of imaged objects: counts, areas, intensity distributions, spatial arrangement, and the segmentation decisions those numbers rest on. NOT biological interpretation, NOT treatment recommendations.

problem.context: shared/plate01.ome.tif is a single-channel 16-bit widefield scan of a 24-well plate, one field per well. Pixel size is recorded in the OME metadata. Wells were seeded identically; the operator suspects an edge effect but the plate was also imaged in two sessions.
problem.goal: Report per-well object counts and area distributions, and determine whether the between-well variation is better explained by well position on the plate than by chance.
success_criteria: A per-well table of object count and median object area, in physical units, with the pixel size you used stated.
The segmentation method named, with the thresholding parameters or cellpose settings that produced the reported counts.
An overlay image per well, checked against `vision.read_image`, so a count that came from debris rather than colonies is caught and said so.
A stated test of position versus chance, with the statistic and its assumptions.
